Name: Abinadab, Son of Saul
Summary: Abinadab, son of Saul, died with his father and brothers on Mount Gilboa when the Philistines defeated Israel.
KeyStory: Abinadab fell on Gilboa with Saul, Jonathan, and Malchi-shua.
RelatedPeople: King Saul; Jonathan; Malchi-shua, Son of Saul
LifeLesson: Loyalty to a failing father can still cost a son everything.
